abilities.name: Firework Flare-Up

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flames will accumulate on the arrowhead before being fired off as an attack. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off a flaming arrow that deals Pyro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Generates a maximum of 3 Kindling Arrows based on time spent charging, releasing them as part of this Aimed Shot. Kindling Arrows will home in on nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG on hit.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

_curatorNotes: N1 has two hitmarks (15, 24); using last hitmark (24) as cancel-frame source per recipe multi-hitmark rule. N4 likewise has two hitmarks (11, 26); using 26.
N values are the InitNormalCancelSlice second arg (animation/N -> next-N frame) — gcsim does not explicitly override ActionAttack on attackFrames. Convention matches amber/fischl bow shape.

chargeHits[1] (Fully-Charged Aimed Shot) frames sourced from aimedFrames[1] InitAbilSlice arg = 97 (no explicit ActionSwap); D/J from explicit ActionDash/ActionJump = aimedHitmarks[1] = 86. gcsim has three additional charge levels for 1/2/3 Kindling Arrows (hitmarks 103/121/139, animLen 114/132/150); not represented — Kindling arrow accumulation is a continuous charge mechanic, the level-1 FCAS is the canonical entry. Reviewer to decide whether per-kindling chargeHits variants are warranted.
No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

abilities.name: Firework Flare-Up (Niwabi Fire-Dance)
abilities.description: Yoimiya's Normal Attack while Niwabi Fire-Dance is active. Arrows become Blazing Arrows, gaining Pyro infusion, an auto-aim assist, and a skill-talent damage multiplier. Charge Level 2 will not generate Kindling Arrows.
_curatorNotes: gcsim uses the same attackFrames/attackHitmarks for in-stance N as for base N — auto-aim is a targeting effect, not a frame change. Frames mirror the base intentionally.

Skill-talent multiplier: gcsim Snapshot() multiplies AttackTagNormal mult by skill[talent] when yoimiyaskill is active. Per-talent table from gcsim yoimiya_gen.go: TL1–15 = 1.617 / 1.738 / 1.859 / 2.020 / 2.140 / 2.260 / 2.420 / 2.581 / 2.741 / 2.901 / 3.061 / 3.221 / 3.422 / 3.622 / 3.823. Reviewer-owned (effect-modeling decision) — not authored as a buff.
ICDTag for in-stance N is ICDTagNormalAttack (vs ICDTagNone on base N) — meaning hits share an ICD group during stance.
Charge Level 2 in-stance does not generate Kindling Arrows (per in-game description and gcsim). The base FCAS hitmark is unchanged; same chargeHits as base.

abilities.name: Niwabi Fire-Dance
abilities.description:
Yoimiya waves a sparkler and causes a ring of saltpeter to surround her.

Niwabi Enshou
During this time, arrows fired by Yoimiya's Normal Attack will be Blazing Arrows, and their DMG will be increased and converted to Pyro DMG. During this time, Normal Attack: Firework Flare-Up will not generate Kindling Arrows at Charge Level 2.

This effect will deactivate when Yoimiya leaves the field.
_curatorNotes: Stance duration = 10s (gcsim AddStatus(skillKey, 600+11, true) — 600 frames effective stance window after 11-frame cast delay).
terminatesOnSwap: true — gcsim onExit() subscribes to OnCharacterSwap and calls DeleteStatus(skillKey) when Yoimiya swaps off-field.
Skill-talent damage multiplier on in-stance N (1.617 → 3.823 across TL1–15) is reviewer-owned; flagged on the in-stance normal entry.

abilities.name: Ryuukin Saxifrage
abilities.description:
Yoimiya leaps into the air along with her original creation, the "Ryuukin Saxifrage," and fires forth blazing rockets bursting with surprises that deal AoE Pyro DMG and mark one of the hit opponents with Aurous Blaze.

Aurous Blaze
All Normal/Charged/Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts by any party member other than Yoimiya that hit an opponent marked by Aurous Blaze will trigger an explosion, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
When an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated before its duration expires, the effect will pass on to another nearby opponent, who will inherit the remaining duration.

One Aurous Blaze explosion can be triggered every 2s. When Yoimiya is down, Aurous Blaze effects created through her skills will be deactivated.
_curatorNotes: Burst hitmark = 75 (gcsim burstHitmark). Initial AoE Pyro damage applies Aurous Blaze debuff to one enemy.

Aurous Blaze is an enemy-attached debuff with a delayed damage callback — borderline summon case per recipe. Lifetime: 600 frames (10s) base, 840 frames (14s) with C1. The schema's summons[] models entity lifetimes anchored to the caster's world; an enemy-attached debuff is not a clean fit. Not authored as summons[]; reviewer to decide representation.

Aurous Blaze trigger: party-member-other-than-Yoimiya N/CA/P/E/Q hit on debuffed enemy → AoE pyro explosion, 2s ICD per enemy (gcsim abIcdKey = 120 frames). Multiplier from gcsim burstExplode[talent]. Effect not authored; reviewer-owned.
Burst frames: ActionAttack at InitAbilSlice default (113, comment 'Q -> N1') — omitted per recipe silent-default rule. swap recorded explicitly at 109.
Burst CD has no explicit cooldownStartDelay (gcsim uses SetCD without delay variant); omitted.

passives.name: Tricks of the Trouble-Maker
passives.description: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, shots from Yoimiya's Normal Attack will increase her Pyro DMG Bonus by 2% on hit. This effect lasts for 3s and can have a maximum of 10 stacks.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely onHit with conditions: { type: 'state', state: 'inStance' } and ability: 'normal' (gcsim a1Key buff, 3s = 180 frame duration, refreshed on each in-stance N hit). 2% per stack, max 10 stacks (50% pyroDmgBonus cap). Schema lacks a 'stacks' field; reviewer to decide stack representation. Inherited value=2 reflects per-stack increment; full uptime cap is 20%.
Buff is gated on Yoimiya being the active character (gcsim checks Player.Active() == c.Index() and StatusIsActive(skillKey)). Reviewer to wire condition.

passives.name: Summer Night's Dawn
passives.description: Using Ryuukin Saxifrage causes nearby party members (not including Yoimiya) to gain a 10% ATK increase for 15s. Additionally, a further ATK Bonus will be added on based on the number of Ascension Talent "Tricks of the Trouble-Maker" stacks Yoimiya possesses when using Ryuukin Saxifrage. Each stack increases this ATK Bonus by 1%.
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onCast burst, target teamExcludingSelf 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim a4 loop skips x.Index() == c.Index(). Buff duration 15s matches gcsim NewBaseWithHitlag('yoimiya-a4', 900).

Stack-conditional bonus (10% base + 1% per A1 stack at cast time, max 20% total) is not authored — schema's per-cast value-snapshotting from external stack state is a deferred primitive. Inherited value=10 reflects the base only; A1 stack contribution lost in the planner.

constellations.name: Agate Ryuukin
constellations.description:
The Aurous Blaze created by Ryuukin Saxifrage lasts for an extra 4s.
Additionally, when an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated within its duration, Yoimiya's ATK is increased by 20% for 20s.
_curatorNotes: Intentionally not authored per stub-with-caveat philosophy 2026-05-14 (onTargetDied category — enemy death state is null-resolving in the planner). Two parts: (a) Aurous Blaze duration 10s → 14s at Cons:1 (gcsim duration = 840 if Cons >= 1) — depends on Aurous Blaze representation, also not authored. (b) On enemy death while debuffed, +20% ATK for 20s self-buff (gcsim 'yoimiya-c1' modifier, 1200 frames). Re-evaluate if a death-tracking primitive ever lands.

constellations.name: A Procession of Bonfires
constellations.description:
When Yoimiya's Pyro DMG scores a CRIT Hit, Yoimiya will gain a 25% Pyro DMG Bonus for 6s.
This effect can be triggered even when Yoimiya is not the active character.
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 F2A migration: trigger:manual → onHit with filter.element:pyro + filter.isCrit:true. gcsim makeC2CB filters on a.IsCrit && Element == Pyro on every Yoimiya hit. Renders on Yoimiya's pyro-infused N hits (burst-active; the parser tags those as elemental-normal), CA hits (always pyro on bow), and skill/burst hits. The renderer's optimistic-fire isCrit semantics treat every hit as a potential crit (filter v1 caveat); the filter primarily serves as a schema-fidelity declaration.

constellations.name: Naganohara Meteor Swarm
constellations.description: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, Yoimiya's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance of firing an extra Blazing Arrow that deals 60% of its original DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
_curatorNotes: Probabilistic extra-hit mechanic: 50% chance per in-stance N for an extra arrow at 60% of total mult. Not modeled — schema has no probabilistic damage-add concept and proc reliability is non-trivial in practice. Reviewer-owned.
